high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously depicts the experience of being bilingual and struggling to remember words in both languages. The top part of the image contains text that reads, "When you're bilingual and you keep forgetting words in both languages." Below the text, there is an image of a person with dark hair styled in loose waves, wearing makeup including eyeliner and eyeshadow. The person appears to be in a formal or semi-formal setting, as suggested by the background which includes a blurred image of what looks like a staircase and possibly some decorative elements.
